name: Zenith

categories.label: Won (met a victory condition first)
categories.hint: Check the winner: first to reach 3 same-planet, 4 different-planet, or 5 Influence discs.

winCondition: Game ends immediately when one player gains 3 Influence discs from the same planet (Absolute), 4 discs from strictly different planets (Democratic), or 5 discs from any planets (Popular). Checked whenever a player takes a Planet token, so there is a single winner.

endCondition.description: First player to meet any of the three Influence victory conditions.

notes: family: race-to-goal. No points. 4-player play is in teams of 2 (teammates alternate turns) with the same victory conditions; winner is the team. Rulebook gives no tie-breaker because the game ends the instant a condition is met.
